description: Source code for the BbrSender class implementing TCP congestion control algorithm in QUIC protocol, including bandwidth estimation, congestion window management, and state transitions.

classes.name: DebugState
classes.description: Struct for exporting internal state of BbrSender for debugging purposes.

methods.name: BbrSender::DebugState(const BbrSender& sender)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes DebugState with current state of BbrSender.

methods.name: BbrSender::DebugState(const DebugState& state)
methods.description: Default copy constructor for DebugState.

methods.name: BbrSender::BbrSender
methods.description: Constructor initializing BbrSender with network parameters, configuration, and state.

methods.name: SetInitialCongestionWindowInPackets
methods.description: Sets the initial congestion window in packets during startup.

methods.name: InSlowStart
methods.description: Checks if the sender is in slow start (startup) mode.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is sent, updating internal state and stats.

methods.name: OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Handles packet neutering event, updating sampler state.

methods.name: CanSend
methods.description: Determines if a packet can be sent based on current bytes in flight.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns current pacing rate, defaulting to high gain * bandwidth if not set.

methods.name: BandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Returns current bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: GetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Returns current congestion window size, considering mode and recovery.

methods.name: GetSlowStartThreshold
methods.description: Returns slow start threshold (not used, always 0).

methods.name: InRecovery
methods.description: Checks if currently in recovery mode.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures sender parameters based on provided QuicConfig.

methods.name: ApplyConnectionOptions
methods.description: Applies connection options based on connection options tags.

methods.name: AdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Adjusts internal state based on network parameters like bandwidth and RTT.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, updating bandwidth, congestion window, and recovery state.

methods.name: GetCongestionControlType
methods.description: Returns the congestion control type (kBBR).

methods.name: GetMinRtt
methods.description: Returns the minimum RTT observed or initial RTT if not available.

methods.name: GetTargetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Calculates target congestion window based on gain.

methods.name: ProbeRttCongestionWindow
methods.description: Returns congestion window during PROBE_RTT mode.

methods.name: EnterStartupMode
methods.description: Transitions sender into startup mode.

methods.name: EnterProbeBandwidthMode
methods.description: Transitions sender into probe bandwidth mode.

methods.name: UpdateRoundTripCounter
methods.description: Updates round trip count based on last acknowledged packet.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateMinRtt
methods.description: Updates min RTT if expired or improved.

methods.name: UpdateGainCyclePhase
methods.description: Advances gain cycle based on current network conditions.

methods.name: CheckIfFullBandwidthReached
methods.description: Checks if full bandwidth has been reached to exit startup.

methods.name: MaybeExitStartupOrDrain
methods.description: Transitions from startup to drain or probe bandwidth.

methods.name: OnExitStartup
methods.description: Handles logic when exiting startup mode.

methods.name: ShouldExitStartupDueToLoss
methods.description: Determines if startup should exit due to loss conditions.

methods.name: MaybeEnterOrExitProbeRtt
methods.description: Handles transition into or out of PROBE_RTT mode.

methods.name: UpdateRecoveryState
methods.description: Updates recovery state based on packet acknowledgments and losses.

methods.name: CalculatePacingRate
methods.description: Calculates pacing rate based on bandwidth estimate and overshoot detection.

methods.name: CalculateCongestionWindow
methods.description: Calculates congestion window based on bandwidth and ACKs.

methods.name: CalculateRecoveryWindow
methods.description: Calculates recovery window based on losses and ACKs.

methods.name: GetDebugState
methods.description: Exports current internal state for debugging.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Handles application-limited state.

methods.name: PopulateConnectionStats
methods.description: Populates connection stats with current data.
